title: Account Terms for the Standby Fee Base, Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
The standby fee base on a Workplace Cafe Management Program contract is taken from the management fee invoicing standing on that contract in the three months up to the day the charge is raised, on the terms below.

#### Term one, recent invoicing below the printed fee
Where the contract carries a management fee invoice in the three months up to the day the charge is raised and the management fee most recently invoiced stands below the monthly management fee printed against the service model, the standby fee base is the management fee most recently invoiced.

#### Term two, recent invoicing at or above the printed fee
Where the contract carries a management fee invoice over the three months up to the day the charge is raised and the management fee most recently invoiced stands at or above the monthly management fee printed against the service model, the standby fee base is the mean of the management fees invoiced over the three months up to the day the charge is raised, rounded to the nearest cent.

#### Term three, no recent invoicing
Where the contract carries no management fee invoice over the three months up to the day the charge is raised, the standby fee base is the monthly management fee printed against the service model.

#### Term four, the records read
The management fee invoices standing on the contract's ledger with a posting day in the three months up to the day the charge is raised, the amount of the management fee most recently invoiced, and the monthly management fee printed against the service model the contract is held in.

#### Term five, worked on hypothetical amounts
Take a hypothetical monthly management fee printed against the service model of 3000.00 USD. Where the management fees invoiced over the three months up to the day the charge is raised are 3000.00 USD, 3061.00 USD and 3120.00 USD, and 3120.00 USD is the one most recently invoiced, that fee stands at or above 3000.00 USD, so the standby fee base is their mean rounded to the nearest cent, which is 3060.33 USD. Where the fee most recently invoiced over the same three months is instead 2880.00 USD, it stands below 3000.00 USD and the standby fee base is 2880.00 USD. Where no management fee invoice stands over the three months up to the day the charge is raised, the standby fee base is the monthly management fee printed against the service model.
